text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, Dec 10 - Chittagong - Dock workers called off strike and resumed work from 2000 hours on 5/12. 15 Vessels in port of which 2 containers, 6 general cargo, 1 cement clinker, 2 foodgrain, 4 other vessels. 29 Vessels due by 17/12 of which 10 containers, 1 cement, 5 general cargo, 1 cement clinker, 6 tankers, 1 seeds, 3 export loaders, 1 scrap, 1 ro/ro. No berthing delays expected, port working normally.

INDIA, DEC 10 - BOMBAY - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 2-3 days, bulk vessels 10-12 days, general cargo 3-4 days. 5 Vessels loading at berth, 21 discharging at berth, 3 discharging at anchorage, 8 waiting at anchorage to load, 15 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 1 Vessel bunkering, 4 under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Calcutta - 21 Vessels due of which 3 coking coal, 5 product tankers, 6 containers, 1 coal, 1 other, 1 phosphoric acid, 1 ammonia, 1 coke, 1 heavy lift/general cargo. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 11 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 1 bunker.

Cochin - Five vessels due, 1-2 days berthing delay expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Vessels under repair/drydock, 1 small fishing vessel, 2 small crafts at drydock, 1 general cargo vessel at Spyard jetty for repairs. No vessels awaiting orders. Mormugao - 11 Vessels due, 4-5 days berthing delay expected. 4 Vessels loading at anchorage, 8 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 1 Vessel bunkering, 4 under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders. Paradip - Vessels due, 2 coal, 2 chrome, 1 fertiliser, 1 chemicals. No delays expected. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

Kandla - Seven vessels due, 7-8 days berthing delay expected. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 9 waiting at anchorage to load. 3 Tankers, 19 tankers waiting. Mangalore - Nine vessels due, 1-2 days berthing delay expected. 2 Vessels loading/discharging at berth, 5 waiting. Madras - 19 Vessels due by 16/12 of which 6 general cargo, 1 sugar, 3 edible oil, 3 coal, 2 containers, 2 iron ore, 2 fertiliser. Delays expected, coal/coke 5 days, fertiliser 4-days, scrap 5-6 days, containers 1-2 days, others 2-3 days. 6 Vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to load. 19 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 under repair/drydock.

Jawaharlal Nehru - No delays expected, 2 tankers due, 1-2 days delay expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth. Tuticorin - Five vessels due, 1-2 days berthing delay expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth. 6 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Visakhapatnam - 14 Vessels due, 7-8 days delay expected. 6 Vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load at inner harbour berth. 11 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth.

MALAYSIA, Dec 11 - Port Kelang - North port - Container berths - 8 Vessels alongside, 7 waiting. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels alongside, 2 berthed, 6 waiting. Waiting time of 2 days. Dry bulk terminal - 1 Vessel alongside, 5 waiting. Waiting time 7 days. West port - 1 Conventional vessel alongside, 2 cement carriers alongside discharging. 1 Wharf occupied by passenger vessel, no wharves vacant, 1 day waiting time.

MAURITIUS, Dec 10 - Port Louis - Port was closed from 1700 hours 7/12 to 0700 hours 9/12 due to bad weather (cyclone Daniella), which passed at 50 kms. sw of Mauritius on 8/12. All vessels vacated berth and returned when weather improved. Berthing delay of 1-2 days being experienced. Three container vessels alongside for discharging and loading, 2 general cargo vessels discharging, 1 vessel loading sugar. 2 Vessels awaiting berth for discharging and loading.

PAKISTAN, Dec 9 - Karachi - Three vessels due with up to 24 hours berthing delay expected. 2-3 Days delay expected for rice loaders. 2 Vessels loading rice at berth, 4 containers loading and discharging at berth, 7 vessels discharging at berth (chemicals, general cargo, urea, dap). 3 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load rice, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge (hsd, crude oil, general cargo, dap), 3 awaiting orders. Port Qasim - Five vessels discharging at berth (sugar, wheat, fuel oil). 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge sugar, wheat, coal, steel slabs.
PHILIPPINES, Dec 9 - Manila - 11 Vessels discharging at pier berth, 5 vessels discharging at anchorage, no berthing delays.

SIERRA LEONE, Dec 9 - Freetown - Vessels due, 3 container dischargers, 1 bauxite loader, 1 clinker discharger, 1 bulk wheat discharger, no delays expected. Vessels discharging/loading at berth, 1 aid cargo discharger, 1 frozen fish discharger, 1 vessel under repair. Vessels anchored, 1 rice discharger, 1 other vessel. Vessels must be in/out of port before 1900 hours.

SINGAPORE, Dec 9 - Singapore - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 7 Container vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 11 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang - 4 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang - 7 General cargo vessels berthed. Jurong port - 14 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminal/sbm buoys - 2 Tankers berthed. Minimum berthing delays at all facilities.

SOUTH KOREA, Dec 10 - Inchon - 73 vessels in port (44 berthed, 29 anchored) of which 9 logs, 7 steel, 6 general cargo, 4 coils, 3 each containers, corn, 2 each pulp, cars, 1 each rape seed meal, peanuts, raw sugar, plywood, sesame, wheat, salt, tapioca. Anchored, 8 logs, 6 general cargo, 4 each corn, containers, 2 steel, 1 each cars, timber, copra, soda, copper. Approx. 3-4 days delay expected. Busan - 173 Vessels in port (47 berthed, 126 anchored including 62 laid up) of which 34 general cargo, 6 containers, 4 scrap, 3 coal. 63 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 2 days day expected.

Pohang - 17 Vessels in port (13 berthed, 4 anchored) of which discharging, 2 coils, 1 each coal, iron ore, mill scale, billets, slabs, pipes. 5 Vessels loading steel, 1-2 vessels awaiting berth with approx. 1 days delay expected. Ulsan - 25 Vessels in port (22 berthed, 3 anchored) of which discharging, 3 woodchip, 1 each coal, coke, cement, mono ethyl glycol, fertiliser, soda ash, iron pyrites, copper concentrate, barite, crude oil. Loading, 3 general cargo, steel pipes, 1 each cyclohexane, fuel oil, diesel. 3 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 3 days delay expected. Masan - Eight vessels berthed of which discharging, 3 steel scrap, 1 tapioca, 1 log. Loading, 2 ciga, 1 container vessel. No berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, Dec 10 - Colombo - Eight vessels due of which 1 breakbulk, 7 containers, 2-3 days delay for conventional vessels. 11 Vessels loading at berth of which 1 essential service, 1 containers. Discharging at berth, 1 bagged sugar, 1 bagged rice, 1 general cargo, 1 bagged flour, 10 containers, 3 bagged fertiliser, 1 bulk palm oil, 1 bulk lpg, 1 bagged cement. 2 General cargo vessels waiting at anchorage to load. 3 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge of which 2 containers, 1 bagged mop. 4 Vessels bunkering, 9 under repair/drydock, 5 awaiting orders. Heavy rain. Galle - Two vessels discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth. Trincomalee - One vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth.
TAIWAN, Dec 10 - Kaohsiung - Vessels in port, 9 containers, 6 tankers, 1 grain, 3 other bulkers, 31 generals, 11 buoys. No vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no berthing delays.
THAILAND, Dec 9 - Bangkok - 85 Vessels in port of which 4 containers, 81 other bulkers and general cargo vessels. 6 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no berthing delays expected.
